Casting float16 NaN values to datetime64 or timedelta64 goes through undefined behavior; on some platforms/builds it yields an 'invalid value' warning instead of NaT, and the loop's input pointer advance was incorrect in earlier patch attempts.
NaN float16 inputs should be converted to NaT (minimum integer, NPY_DATETIME_NAT), so that np.array([np.nan]*5, dtype=np.float16).astype('m8[s]') yields an all-NaT array without any warning.
